critic.fix_suggestion: Add vertical rectangular planes at the main cabin door locations to represent structural seams. Set the width of these planes to 0.15 units (or 2% of the fuselage diameter) and position them along the fuselage's curvature. For each door, include a recessed frame effect by offsetting the plane slightly inward from the skin surface by 0.05 units.

discrepancies.observed: A single large dark block at the nose
discrepancies.reference: A multi-paneled cockpit window array with distinct vertical and horizontal dividers

discrepancies.observed: A series of small, evenly spaced dots along the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Continuous rows of rectangular windows following the curvature of the hull
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: replace dots with elongated thin boxes

discrepancies.observed: No visible door lines or structural breaks in the fuselage skin
discrepancies.reference: Distinct vertical seams and recessed frames for main cabin doors
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add vertical rectangular planes at door locations

discrepancies.observed: Windows appear to be placed on a flat plane across the side
discrepancies.reference: Windows follow the slight taper and curvature of the fuselage body
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: curve window positions along the cylinder's arc
